title: TraperCraft
description: In This plugin you trap player they cannot move with ender pearl or anything like teleportation if it's die it spawn here where you trap he
body:
In This plugin you trap player they cannot move with ender pearl or anything like teleportation if it's die it spawn here where you trap he

**Commands**

/trap to trap player

/untrap to untrap player

**License:-** 
            License key is very important first upload the plugin to your host plugin folder then start the server then go to files then plugin then open TraperCraft folder then go to config.yml then in License paste in these to dots "" like that "**TRAPER5521**" then save the file go to console and restart the server and you are good to go 😄


very simple and lite plugin 😀 for your server
